# NEW 2026-11-18 stories of imperial finance. Generated by gen_imperial_finance.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly. From 1338.1.1, 8 months after the last finance story, 8% a month.
# Never fires for Fourth Rome exile countries or during the 1453-1455 non-1337 opening/pre-departure window.
oe_fin_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            current_date >= 1338.1.1
            NOT = { oe_is_fourth_rome_exile_country = yes }
            NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_elr_exile_active }
            NOT = { AND = { NOT = { oe_start_is_1337 = yes } current_year >= 1453 current_year <= 1455 } }
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_fin_cd }
            oe_story_gap_open = yes
            oe_fin_any_ok = yes
        }
        random = { chance = 8 oe_fin_dispatch = yes }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. One eligible story by weight.
oe_fin_dispatch = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_fin } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_fin value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_fin add = 1 }  # third round T3: event count
    set_variable = { name = oe_fin_cd months = 8 }
    oe_story_gap_set = yes
    random_list = {
        10 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_1 = yes } oe_fin_start_1 = yes }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_2 = yes } oe_fin_start_2 = yes }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_2 = yes at_war = yes } oe_fin_start_2 = yes }
        15 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_3 = yes } oe_fin_start_3 = yes }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_4 = yes } oe_fin_start_4 = yes }
        15 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_5 = yes } oe_fin_start_5 = yes }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_6 = yes } oe_fin_start_6 = yes }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_7 = yes } oe_fin_start_7 = yes }
        20 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_8 = yes } oe_fin_start_8 = yes }
        20 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_9 = yes } oe_fin_start_9 = yes }
        20 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_10 = yes } oe_fin_start_10 = yes }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_11 = yes } oe_fin_start_11 = yes }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_12 = yes } oe_fin_start_12 = yes }
        15 = { trigger = { oe_fin_ok_13 = yes } oe_fin_start_13 = yes }
    }
}

        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_fin.1

# BYZ scope. Saves the bank country of a branch as scope:oe_fin_bank (the one seated in the city first).
oe_fin_save_bank_tsbk = {
    random_subject = { limit = { is_subject_type = oe_bank capital ?= { this = location:thessaloniki } } save_scope_as = oe_fin_bank }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_fin_bank } } random_subject = { limit = { oe_fin_bank_at_tsbk = yes } save_scope_as = oe_fin_bank } }
}

# BYZ scope. The running campaign: progress +$bonus$, pressure $pressure$.
oe_fin_campaign_push = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } oe_hc_egypt_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_egypt_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } oe_hc_africa_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_africa_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } oe_hc_italy_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_italy_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } oe_hc_france_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_france_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } oe_hc_iberia_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_iberia_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } oe_hc_britain_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_britain_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } oe_hc_persia_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_persia_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } oe_hc_blacksea_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_blacksea_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } oe_hc_arabia_add_bonus = { amount = $bonus$ } oe_hc_arabia_add_pressure = { amount = $pressure$ } }
}

# Test helper: console 'effect oe_fin_fire = { n = 3 }' runs story 3's start (theme pick, 20-year mark, event).
